notes.title: SPEEDRUNNER version 1.4.0 Update description
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

SPEEDRUNNER has gotten a graphical update. What do you think of the new drip?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43139978/aa7c1e87804a7fb0bd74166f3d55836b5d9fcaa7.png[/img]

Two new levels are ready for you as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43139978/0f6a6eb86028a6cd85de978e2d809ae717b87a0c.png[/img]

Additions:

[list]
[*]Gloves customization
[*]Gloves rewards added to tutorial and to some levels
[*]Togglable timer visibility
[*]New features inside Practice Area
[*]Global & Friend leaderboards to Pause Menu
[*]Chinese characters visible on leaderboards
[*]New level 9 with leaderboard and achievement
[*]New level 10 with leaderboard and achievement
[*]Total of 4 new achievements added
[/list]

Changes:

[list]
[*]Graphical update: Boots, Shirts, Character
[*]Minor obstacle changes (will not affect world records)
[*]UI Menus updated
[*]Time spent in practice area now displays inside and registers immediately
[*]If level 7 cleared, level 8 is now unlocked. (Old: 3 stars on level 7 requirement)
[*]SR Master achievement unset. New requirement: Total time less than 380s and all levels cleared
[*]All levels 3 stars-achievement unset, as new levels are uploaded
[*]Some rewards are relocated
[*]Ground plane objects to prevent distortion

[*]Bugfixes regarding
[olist]
[*]Local highscore saving
[*]Button presses
[*]Minor bugs
[/olist]
[/list]
